data.claim: Resumption safety depends on the distinction between budget-exhaustion halts and all other halt causes. Budget-exhaustion halts are resumable iff the event log maintains a monotonic, content-addressed identity chain (each event's ID is a hash of its content plus the prior event's ID) and the halt did not interrupt a write. Any halt caused by crash, power loss, or process kill—rather than graceful budget exhaustion—must be refused resumption pending a full integrity audit, because the causal mechanism of the halt differs.
